answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits, registers a plume station and files a signed plume count per epoch. A nebula beacon draws random pairs; an auditor checks both per station, and a delta over 5% burns the bond; a station serving two keys burns both. Fees: 32 first, 32+6(k-1) for the k-th, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Named failure: rented-station ring; an honest agent pays 32 once, reclaims the bond after audit.
